## Teaching and Mentoring

### Teaching

**Instructor, 2.003 Dynamics and Control I**, MIT Department of Mechanical Engineering, Fall 2025. I led three weekly recitation sections and office hours for the core undergraduate dynamics subject.

**Teaching Assistant, SIO 211A Ocean Waves**, Scripps Institution of Oceanography, Winter 2022.

### Mentoring

**Undergraduate research (UROP), MIT**, 2025–present. I supervised two undergraduates developing instrumentation to measure air–water carbon dioxide fluxes, and am now mentoring a student on laboratory experiments and data processing with the [RTSSV particle camera](/research/projects/RTSSV).

**Environment, Health, and Safety Representative**, Environmental Dynamics Laboratory, MIT, 2025–present. I coordinate laboratory safety and compliance and train undergraduate and graduate students in safe laboratory practice.

**Peer Mentor**, Scripps Institution of Oceanography graduate program, 2019–2022.
